purpose: Shared-agent evaluation scenarios for the Zendesk backlog trend analysis skill. These scenarios use synthetic data and expected behaviour checks only.

scenarios.prompt: Give me the current open Zendesk backlog health for the support queue. Include ageing risk, ownership gaps, repeated themes, and 3 priority actions.
required_behaviours: mark SLA unavailable when SLA fields are not visible
forbidden_behaviours: assume SLA breach without visible SLA data
depend on a private Zendesk view

scenarios.prompt: Are checkout-related tickets increasing compared with the previous 7 days?
required_evidence: comparison window ticket counts or explicit unavailable comparison
required_behaviours: use matching filters across windows when comparison is possible
state when comparison data is unavailable
forbidden_behaviours: compare mismatched scopes without saying so
claim a trend without comparison evidence
claim a root cause without ticket evidence

scenarios.prompt: Review the last 7 days of open and newly created Zendesk tickets for repeated customer pain.
required_evidence: repeated wording tags workflow or product area evidence
required_behaviours: classify patterns as likely duplicate related but distinct repeated support pain possible incident signal or inconclusive
forbidden_behaviours: declare an incident without confirmed shared cause
turn every repeat into a product recommendation
merge or update tickets without explicit write request

scenarios.prompt: Try to produce a backlog health report. If the active agent cannot see counts, metadata, SLA, or ticket details, explain the limitation without inventing data.
required_behaviours: refuse to produce an evidence-backed report when counts or metadata are unavailable
forbidden_behaviours: infer queue health from no data

scenarios.prompt: Turn the backlog summary into customer replies for the affected tickets.
required_evidence: specific ticket context before drafting replies
required_behaviours: route to a customer-facing support reply workflow when available
avoid drafting unsupported customer replies from aggregate trends only
request or collect ticket-level evidence before customer-facing wording
forbidden_behaviours: draft customer replies from aggregate trend evidence alone
perform Zendesk write actions without explicit request
